verdict.rationale: Forter documents a public REST API reference: Order v3 for checkout decisions, Order Status updates, an Evidence API for disputes, and signed notification webhooks. A sandbox/TEST environment supports integration work, and machine-readable llms.txt docs plus an official MCP server make it reachable for AI-native workflows. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented, and evidence that policy/decision management (not just order submission) is exposed via the raw API rather than only via MCP.
